description: sfxnz's two-Spark GLM-5.3-Flash recipe (kit 22cfa239): the stock TensorFold 1.2.5 release (no fork, no patches) at TP=2 over the direct RoCE link, serving sfxnz's EXL3 4bpw pack (routed experts EXL3 4 bpw, the rest Z.AI's BF16) with vision, thinking and MTP drafts on. Up to 8 requests at once and one request up to 1,048,576 tokens, sharing one BF16 KV pool (2,117 to 2,315 pages per rank, by the memory free at load) with up to 16 kept prompt states (TF_KV_SHARE 16, 175 MiB each); dense linears and the head are packed to 8 bits at load (TF_GLM_DENSE_BITS/HEAD_BITS 8, within sfxnz's 0.002 nats/token gate), and each stream rows off 64 video-token slots because the image carries no libtfvideo. The creator publishes no image: the image installs the checksummed release archive on NVIDIA's CUDA 13.0 base, and Controller placement supplies rank, rendezvous and RoCE rails instead of run.sh's ssh and docker. Memory is an estimate from the engine's own accounting (83.0 GiB weights + 12.8 GiB for the 1M window's pages + 1.5 GiB for the other 7 streams, the 2.8 GiB of KV_SHARE slots taken from what is left, 10.5 GiB host reserve kept; the creator's gate is 109 GiB MemAvailable per node); upstream figures (35.4 tok/s at 1 stream, 60.7 tok/s aggregate at 8, a needle served at 1,047,584 tokens) are the creator's, not measured here.
title: GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 4bpw TensorFold dual Spark (sfxnz)
